REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - JUNE 4, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
June 4, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Commissioner Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri
  Vice Chair Jose “Armin” Reyes
  Chair Gloria Perlas Pulido

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila
  Director of Public Works Alvin Papa
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  Senior Planner Jeremy Loh
  Associate Planner Wyman Wong

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Vice Chair Reyes.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Pulido invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no one wishing to address the Planning Commission,
  Chair Pulido closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, May 8, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Special Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Ao, and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan, to approve the Thursday, May 8, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Special Meeting Minutes.

City of Cerritos  June 4, 2025
Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Jhaveri, Reyes, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Hearing Notice

6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE  CERRITOS  PLANNING  COMMISSION  APPROVING  WIRELESS
  TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2025-1, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT COASTAL
  BUSINESS GROUP INC., ON BEHALF OF AT&T MOBILITY, TO CONSTRUCT A NEW
  WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON AN EXISTING SOUTHERN
  CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER. THE PROPOSED WIRELESS
  FACILITY WILL CONTAIN TWELVE (12) PANEL ANTENNAS, NINE (9) REMOTE
  RADIO UNITS, AND THREE (3) SURGE SUPPRESSION BOXES MOUNTED ON THE
  TOWER, AND LOCATED BENEATH THE TOWER WILL BE A NEW EQUIPMENT
  ENCLOSURE CONTAINING FIVE (5) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS AND ONE (1)
  GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION
  PURPOSES. THE SUBJECT TOWER IS LOCATED ON A SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA
  EDISON PROPERTY, GENERALLY LOCATED NORTH OF ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND
  EAST OF THE SAN GABRIEL RIVER CHANNEL, AND IS ZONED OPEN SPACE
  OVERLAY (OS-1) (APN 7034-001-803).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15303 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Wyman Wong. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed new wireless
  telecommunication facility on behalf of AT&T Mobility on an existing Southern
  California Edison transmission tower. Mr. Wong continued his presentation of the
  proposed project and existing property conditions providing details on the proposed
  wireless facility and the contents of twelve (12) panel antennas, nine (9) remote
  radio units, and three (3) surge suppression boxes mounted on the tower, and
  located beneath the tower will be a new equipment enclosure containing five (5)
  support equipment cabinets and one (1) global positioning antenna for wireless
  telecommunication purposes. Mr. Wong continued his presentation showing the
  potential wireless coverage that will be achieved by the installation of the proposed
  new wireless telecommunication facility.

  Discussion followed as Mrs. Aguila provided clarification regarding the City of Cerritos
  Wireless Telecommunication Facility Criteria Checklist in conformance with Section
  22.42.120 of the Cerritos Municipal Code. Commissioner Jhaveri inquired about the
  quantity of wireless telecommunication facilities in the City of Cerritos and Mr. Wong
  estimated there are about sixty (60) wireless telecommunication facilities in the City
  of Cerritos. Vice Chair Reyes inquired about the coverage of the proposed facility and
  who will potentially benefit from the proposed new wireless telecommunication
  facility. Mrs. Aguila provided clarification that the proposed wireless
  telecommunication facility will provide coverage to Cerritos residents, Bellflower
  residents and any person visiting or driving through the affected area.

  Chair Pulido opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Pulido
  declared public comments closed.

City of Cerritos  June 4, 2025
Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2025-8: A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION
  PERMIT 2025-1, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT COASTAL BUSINESS GROUP INC., ON
  BEHALF OF AT&T MOBILITY, TO CONSTRUCT A NEW WIRELESS
  TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON AN EXISTING SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON
  TRANSMISSION TOWER. THE PROPOSED WIRELESS FACILITY WILL CONTAIN
  TWELVE (12) PANEL ANTENNAS, NINE (9) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, AND THREE (3)
  SURGE SUPPRESSION BOXES MOUNTED ON THE TOWER, AND LOCATED BENEATH
  THE TOWER WILL BE A NEW EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE CONTAINING FIVE (5)
  SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINETS AND ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA FOR
  WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. THE SUBJECT TOWER IS LOCATED ON
  A SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON PROPERTY, GENERALLY LOCATED NORTH OF
  ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND EAST OF THE SAN GABRIEL RIVER CHANNEL,. AND IS
  ZONED OPEN SPACE OVERLAY (OS-1) (APN 7034-001-803).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Jhaveri, Reyes, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  New and Old Business

7A.  Review and comment by the Cerritos Planning Commission on an administrative
  approval of a Minor Precise Plan proposal by Chick-fil-A for interior and exterior
  improvements at an existing restaurant building located at Los Cerritos Center. The
  subject property is located at 18605 Gridley Road, Cerritos, California 90703 and is
  zoned Regional Commercial (CR) (APN 7038-014-023).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed, providing details about the Minor Precise Plan proposed by Chick-fil-A.
  Mr. Loh provided details regarding the proposed interior and exterior improvements
  at the existing restaurant building located at the Los Cerritos Center. The proposed
  interior improvements include new finishes, furniture, and system upgrades to
  enhance the existing dining space. He continued with details regarding exterior
  improvements, which include the addition of a 360-square-foot restaurant storage
  area, the expansion of an existing drive-through service lane canopy, the
  construction of an additional drive-through service lane canopy, and the relocation of
  an existing trash area.

  Mr. Loh concluded by noting that one (1) public comment was received related to the
  proposed project. A representative of Chick-fil-A and the project Civil Engineer was
  present at the meeting to answer any questions from the Planning Commission.
  Discussion followed regarding the Chick-fil-A community partnership. Commissioner
  Ao asked for clarification on the reorientation of the trash enclosure and materials
  used for the construction of the proposed canopies. Commissioner Chauhan
  commented on the benefits of the canopies over the drive-through service lanes.
  Chair Pulido opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Pulido
  declared public comments closed. The Planning Commission received and filed the
  report.
City of Cerritos  June 4, 2025
Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes  Page 3
 7B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION FINDING THE PROPOSED CITY OF CERRITOS
  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 IN CONFORMITY
  WITH THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN.

  A staff report was given by Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing background information on the City’s Capital
  Improvement Program (CIP). Mr. Lee continued his presentation, providing details of
  upcoming public improvements to government buildings, parks and open spaces,
  sewer improvements, streets and highways, and traffic signals.

  Discussion continued regarding pedestrian safety, LED lighting, and park projects.
  Pedestrian safety was discussed as it pertains to the Cerritos Center for the
  Performing Arts Accessibility ramps and handrails. The Annual Citywide facility LED
  light conversion comes from fluorescent lights no longer being available in the State
  of California as of January 1, 2025. Mr. Lee concluded by noting that one (1) public
  comment was received related to the proposed project.

  Chair Pulido opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Pulido
  declared public comments closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner
  Ao to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2025-9: A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION FINDING THE PROPOSED CITY OF CERRITOS
  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 IN CONFORMITY
  WITH THE CERRITOS G ENERAL PLAN.

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Jhaveri, Reyes, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Review and consideration of a Commissioner’s suggestion to establish a new Single-
  Family Residential Zone, RS-4000, pursuant to the City of Cerritos Commission and
  Committee Scope of Authority Policy (Policy 6.02).

  A staff report was given by Advanced Planning Manager Sabrina Chan regarding the
  May 8, 2025 Planning Commission meeting, and Commissioner Chauhan
  expressing interest in the establishment of a new Single-Family Residential Zone,
  RS-4000, in an effort to allow new single-family residential development on smaller
  parcel sizes in the City of Cerritos. Mrs. Chan provided introductory information on
  zoning and the current zones applied in the City of Cerritos. Currently, all residential
  properties located within the City have a residential zoning designation.

  Mrs. Chan concluded her presentation by stating that the Planning Commission’s role
  is to serve as an advisory body to the City Council regarding long-range and current
  planning and development projects and the implementation of the City’s Municipal
  Code. Mrs. Chan explained that Commissioner Chauhan’s request to establish a new
  single-family residential zone, RS-4000, would be categorized as a special project
  request, which would need approval by the City Council and have substantial costs
  associated with the required environmental analysis pursuant to CEQA requirements.
  As such, the information Mrs. Chan provided in her report provides a preliminary
City of Cerritos  June 4, 2025
Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes  Page 4
   overview of the matter. City staff sought direction from the Planning Commission
  regarding referring the special project to the City Council for consideration to allocate
  staff time accordingly.

  Chair Pulido opened the public hearing. Cerritos Mayor Frank Yokoyama commented
  on the presentation given by Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan and Director
  of Community Development Kristin Aguila. Mr. Yokoyama expressed his appreciation
  for the refresher on zoning in the City of Cerritos and thanked Chair Pulido for her
  years of service to the Planning Commission and the City of Cerritos. Seeing and
  hearing no speakers, Chair Pulido declared public comments closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Ao and seconded by Vice Chair Reyes to
  receive and file, take no further action on the Commissioner’s suggestion to establish
  a new Single-Family Residential Zone, RS-4000, pursuant to the City of Cerritos
  Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy (Policy 6.02).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Jhaveri, Reyes, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Reports

8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila reported on the fulfillment of the
  Current Planning Manager position. Mrs. Aguila introduced Amanda Acuna to the
  Planning Commission, providing insight into her role in the department. Mrs. Aguila
  continued by commending Chair Pulido for her years of service on the Planning
  Commission, specifically related to the valuable insight and thoughtfulness Chair
  Pulido brought forward in her review of projects. Mrs. Aguila concluded by informing
  the Commission that the next Planning Commission meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, July 2, 2025.

8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Ao, Commissioner Chauhan, Commissioner
  Jhaveri, Vice Chair Reyes, and Chair Pulido.

9.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:50 p.m.
